description: Shared decision table for the bright-line guards. parity.bats runs every case through the Claude and Codex bash guards (and the Codex guards as pi runs them); the pi in-process guard runs the same table. Decision grammar and expectation rules: parity.bash. A case's files are created under the sandbox project, its reads/warns rows and turn epoch are written under the state key of key_source (default parity-session), and {project} stands for the sandbox project in every string.
